nodes.description: Public mapping(bytes32 => uint256) tracking the ether balance of each named account.
Public mapping(bytes32 => address) binding a named account to the wallet address allowed to withdraw from it.
Public mapping(address => bool) whitelist of addresses allowed to approve account owners.
Internal address of the contract owner, set once in the constructor.
Constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender and gates it into the oracle whitelist.
Owner-only function that sets _oracles[oracle] = true.
Owner-only function that clears an oracle flag, refusing to remove the owner oracle.
Payable function that credits msg.value to a named account balance and emits DepositEvent.
Function that transfers the full balance of a named account to the bound wallet, then zeroes the balance.
Oracle-only function binding a wallet address to a named account in _usersByAddress.
Caller-controlled address used in access control requires, the deposit event, recipient lookup and the constructor.
Unchecked arithmetic: _userBalances[account] += msg.value under Solidity ^0.6.11, susceptible to overflow/underflow.
External ether transfer payable(_usersByAddress[account]).transfer(_userBalances[account]) executed before the balance is reset.
Privilege guards comparing owner == msg.sender and _oracles[msg.sender] to authorize privileged entry points.
bytes32 account argument of deposit used as the balance mapping key.
bytes32 account argument of withdraw used to resolve the caller, recipient and amount.
address wallet argument of approveAddress written into _usersByAddress.
bytes32 account argument of approveAddress used as the mapping key.
address oracle argument of enableOracle whitelisted as an oracle.
address oracle argument of disableOracle whose flag is cleared.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner and used as the _oracles lookup key in the onlyOwner/onlyOracles guards.
Constructor derives the privileged owner identity directly from msg.sender.
deposit emits msg.sender as the depositor in DepositEvent.
deposit's account parameter is the mapping key for the unchecked balance increment.
The unchecked += writes the credited value into _userBalances.
deposit reaches the balance increment after the msg.value > 0 check.
withdraw's account parameter drives the recipient/amount resolution preceding the external transfer.
Recipient address of the transfer is read from _usersByAddress.
Transfer amount is read from _userBalances before any state reset.
Balance is zeroed only after the external transfer completes (state update after interaction).
withdraw executes the external transfer before updating state, enabling classic reentrancy.
The external ether transfer can transfer control back into withdraw while the balance is still set.
approveAddress wallet parameter is stored into _usersByAddress.
approveAddress account parameter indexes the _usersByAddress mapping.
approveAddress performs the mapping write to bind wallet to account.
enableOracle writes the oracle parameter into _oracles as true.
enableOracle executes the oracle whitelist update.
disableOracle writes the oracle parameter into _oracles as false.
disableOracle executes the oracle whitelist update.
The onlyOracles guard reads _oracles[msg.sender] to authorize callers.
The onlyOwner guard reads the owner state variable for the msg.sender comparison.
Constructor initializes owner with msg.sender, establishing privileged access.
Constructor sets _oracles[owner] = true.
disableOracle compares the target oracle against owner so the owner oracle cannot be removed.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter of deposit only exists to index the deposit balance write, so it is absorbed into the deposit function node.
The account parameter of withdraw is local plumbing for the recipient/amount lookup, absorbed into the withdraw function node.
The wallet parameter of approveAddress merely supplies the value written by the function, so it merges into approveAddress.
The account parameter of approveAddress is only a mapping key for the function's write and merges into approveAddress.
The oracle parameter of enableOracle is the value assigned by the function and is absorbed into enableOracle.
The oracle parameter of disableOracle is only used for the whitelist update and merges into disableOracle.
